outcomes.key_finding: Fixed-vocabulary classifier cannot achieve 80% coverage floor on Hex.pm; fundamental limit due to package naming diversity; when classified, need-related (78) vs random (6) distinction is meaningful
Dependency lockfile closures drift over time on public projects, confirming E2s untested status and real-world drift

matched_harvest_design.key_finding: Design correctly addresses E113/F116 harvest artifact defect (asymmetric harvest invalidates effect size), but coverage floor limitation prevents effect size measurement without both arms classified

boundary_conditions.arrival_metadata_required: principle works only on platforms with view_count/download_count
boundary_conditions.candidate_seat_empty: no population large enough to justify an invention claimed
boundary_conditions.e078_classification: defaults to technique-or-expertise for import/error titles
boundary_conditions.hnews_need_classification: 3% need-related rate insufficient for gate G1; title keywords default to general interest
boundary_conditions.ruby_gems_threshold_issue: 100% active rate for both need-related and random groups, consistent with crates.io; principle does not discriminate on platforms where all packages have download activity

summary.view_count_instrument: final standing: independent arrivals at need on every row
